description:
Device configuration installation status by device.

TIP: Per-device status of one device configuration profile (classic profiles and Windows Update for Business rings; Settings catalog policies use get-configuration-policy-device-status instead). Each has deviceDisplayName, userPrincipalName, userName, deviceModel, platform, status (unknown, notApplicable, compliant, remediated, nonCompliant, error, conflict, notAssigned), complianceGracePeriodExpirationDateTime and lastReportedDateTime. Filter with $filter=status eq 'error'. Supports $filter, $top, $skip, $select, $orderby, $count.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-device-configuration-device-statuses
